items.title: Draft the product brief
items.notes: Documented the target players and GMs, v1 goals and non-goals, and the definition of done.

items.title: Map the character workflows and screens
items.notes: Drafted ego creation, morph assignment, resleeving, and export flows, plus the information architecture and key screen requirements.

items.title: Outline the technical design and testing plan
items.notes: Sketched the TypeScript domain model, traced calculations, local-first storage, and planned verification layers.

items.title: Document delivery milestones and open decisions
items.notes: Published milestones and exit criteria from discovery through public beta.

items.title: Publish contributor documentation and the roadmap
items.notes: Added the documentation entry points, agent guidance, and versioned roadmap files.

items.title: Select and set up the React host framework
items.notes: Selected Vite with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Added a checked build, calculation tests, and local setup commands.

items.title: Save and reload a draft ego and sleeve
items.notes: Added identity and aptitude editing, optional first-morph assignment, and atomic IndexedDB persistence. Verified the ego and sleeve survive a browser reload.

items.title: Confirm licensing and attribution requirements
items.notes: Documented the publisher's CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 terms, product-specific notices, logo policy, and attribution for adapted game material. Added app and dossier credit.

items.title: Decide which creation pathways v1 supports
items.notes: Selected core package-buy against Second Edition errata 1.4 and documented the supported workflow and deferred alternatives.

items.title: Inventory the rules data and source references
items.notes: Mapped the draft checks, Quick-Start morph profiles, creation rules and errata, pools, and dossier field references in docs/rules-sources.md.

items.title: Assign a sourced sample morph
items.notes: Added Bouncer, Case, and Synth Quick-Start health profiles with page links. Verified assignment and reload in a browser. Legacy drafts retain their original assignments.

items.title: Calculate sleeve stats with a trace
items.notes: Replaced illustrative morph adjustments with the published aptitude score × 3 check. The dossier shows each calculation and the independently sourced morph health values.

items.title: Browse and compare Quick-Start morph profiles
items.notes: Added text search, category filters, three-profile health comparisons, and source links. Verified keyboard controls, selection across filters, and narrow-screen table scrolling in the browser.

items.title: Preserve sleeve history during resleeving
items.notes: Added before-and-after morph comparison, optional event details, and an append-only sleeve history. Verified legacy migration, save order, reload, and later ego edits.

items.title: Export and re-import character backups
items.notes: Added single-ego and workspace exports, validated preview, legacy migration reporting, and atomic restore as new copies. Verified malformed-file rejection and round-tripped a saved sleeve history in the browser.

items.title: Print player and GM dossiers
items.notes: Added player and compact GM print layouts, opt-in controls for private sleeve fields, and browser print styling. Verified privacy choices and the mobile preview. Native print pagination remains part of the accessibility and layout audit.

items.title: Apply core aptitude templates and show their CP cost
items.notes: Added the seven core templates, a live ledger for aptitude points and their share of CP, starting range and maximum warnings, and source attribution. Verified template application, redistribution, CP changes, and saving and reopening an ego in the browser.

items.title: Choose and save starter core packages
items.notes: Added a sourced set of background, career, interest, and faction choices, with individual skill grants, optional Know fields, and faction motivation. Verified persistence, player preview, and backup validation.

items.title: Calculate starting skills from package grants and aptitudes
items.notes: Summed matching grants with source labels, added linked bases and doubled Fray and Perceive, tracked unnamed Know points, and displayed totals above the standard cap. Verified Art classification and the saved ledger after reload.

items.title: Add an original orbital favicon
items.notes: Created a cyan crescent and orbital arc on a dark rounded tile, and used the same artwork for the browser favicon and navigation brand button.

items.title: Save point transfers between listed starting skills
items.notes: Added ordered transfers with source balances, Know restrictions, destination cap checks, and revalidation after aptitude or package changes. Verified adding, rejecting, saving, reopening, and removing transfers.

items.title: Use browser routes for workspace screens
items.notes: Added direct URLs for the morph library, backup restore, and ego workflows. Verified direct links, refresh, draft save, Back and Forward, unsaved-edit protection, and recovery for missing pages and egos.

items.title: Transfer starting points to new Active and Know skills
items.notes: Added rulebook Active skill destinations, named Know fields, and optional Art classification at creation. Verified the starting cap, Know-only restrictions, saving, reloading, removal, and backup round-trips.

items.title: Share customization points between aptitudes and skill purchases
items.notes: Added skill purchases in five-point batches with a shared aptitude and skill CP budget. Verified split purchases, cap warnings, draft and backup persistence, and CP refunds on removal.

items.title: Add ego Flex and languages to the shared CP budget
items.notes: Added the ego Flex cap, aptitude-based language allowance, both CP costs, and dossier and print preview output. Verified cost changes, duplicate handling, persistence, and older draft defaults.

items.title: Allocate starting reputation and buy extra points with CP
items.notes: Added seven core networks, the 100 free points, the 80-point cap per network, and extra reputation spending in the shared CP budget. Verified draft and backup persistence and both print previews.

items.title: Buy skill specializations with CP
items.notes: Added named specialties for ledger skills, one CP per choice, and a separate situational target. Verified the standard cap, duplicate checks, backups, reload, print previews, and removal refunds.

items.title: Add starter ego trait costs and bonuses
items.notes: Added six sourced ego traits with levels, positive costs, and the six-CP negative trait bonus cap. Verified changing the available budget, rejecting excess bonuses, backups, reload, and both print previews.

items.title: Add custom Active skill fields to the starting ledger
items.notes: Added custom Hardware, Medicine, Pilot, and Exotic fields with linked aptitudes, transfers, purchases, and specializations. Verified backup validation, draft reload, and a custom specialization in print preview.

items.title: Apply the Expert Training starting skill cap
items.notes: Added the two-CP trait and the 90-point cap for one chosen skill. Verified transfer and purchase checks, validation on removal, backup preservation, draft reload, and the print preview.

items.title: Add Colonist, Enclaver, Explorer, and Spacer packages
items.notes: Added sourced grants and open Hardware and Pilot fields with rulebook suggestions. Verified pending points, matching field merges, cap warnings, backup validation, draft reload, and player package names.

items.title: Record starting faction and personal motivations
items.notes: Added faction defaults and overrides, support and opposition, and a third personal choice for unaffiliated egos. Verified legacy Factionless text, backup validation, saved faction changes, and player print output.

items.title: Record optional short-term goals for motivations
items.notes: Added one goal per faction or personal motivation. Verified draft and backup persistence, player print output, and goals saved before naming a motivation or while a personal slot is inactive.

items.title: Choose starting campaign and career gear packs
items.notes: Added the core campaign packs, three supported career packs, and the free muse. Verified Gear Point totals, first-sleeve synthmorph alternatives, backup validation, draft reload, and player print output.

items.title: Draft and review the core screen wireframes
items.notes: Reviewed core screens and completed the grayscale dossier review using Edge PDFs at A4 and Letter. Added missing skill totals, pending and over-cap warnings, darker preview warnings, and pagination fixes. Checked backup restore and reload, private-field selection and reset, repeated table headers, attribution, and the narrow preview. See docs/print-review.md for scope and remaining accessibility work.

items.title: Add Enforcer and Soldier careers and gear packs
items.notes: Added sourced skill grants, optional Know fields, 10-GP gear packs, Restricted labels, corrected five-dose quantities, and the Soldier synthmorph replacement. Verified combined Fray totals, transfers, save and reload, career changes, backups and restore, first-sleeve gear preservation during resleeving, narrow layouts, and grayscale player PDFs.

items.title: Add Hacker, Scavenger, Scientist, and Techie careers and gear packs
items.notes: Added sourced skill grants, optional Hardware, Pilot, and Know fields, matching 10-GP gear packs, and Hacker app restrictions. Verified pending fields, custom fields and merged Demolitions grants, source costs, save and reload, backup restore, narrow previews, and grayscale player PDFs.

items.title: Consolidate workspace navigation in a top navbar
items.notes: Moved the brand, My egos, Morph library, Create ego, Import JSON, and local workspace indicator into one shared top navbar. Removed the separate status bar and visible Prototype wording. Checked layouts from 280 to 1440 pixels, active links, keyboard focus, skip navigation, unsaved-edit prompts, and print hiding. Recorded the navigation decision and updated contributor and user docs.

items.title: Complete the core career catalogue and matching gear packs
items.notes: Added Covert Operative, Genehacker, Investigator, Medic, and Mindhacker, completing all 14 core careers. Included source grants, optional Know fields, Covert Operative's synthmorph swap, Medic and Mindhacker errata, and Genehacker's unresolved payload cost qualifier. Verified partial drafts, skill caps and transfers, save and reload, backups and restore, first-sleeve preservation during resleeving, mobile previews, and grayscale player PDFs.

items.title: Add the remaining non-Psi backgrounds and combat skill choices
items.notes: Added Indenture, Infolife, Isolate, Underclass, and Uplift with sourced skill grants, open fields, and restricted Fray/Melee or Guns/Melee choices. Verified pending drafts, linked aptitudes and doubled bases, transfer revalidation, backup validation and restore, save and reload, keyboard controls, narrow layouts, and player/GM PDF output. Lost remains tied to the outstanding Psi work.

items.title: Complete core faction choices and regional affiliations
items.notes: Added the remaining core factions and six concrete regional affiliations under a native Regional group, for 21 named choices plus Factionless. Preserved existing ids, 30-point Know grants, custom motivation text and goals, and the inactive third personal slot. Verified all named choices, missing aptitudes, grant merging and caps, old-faction Know transfers, save and reload, backup restore, keyboard access, mobile layout, and player/GM PDF output.

items.title: Complete the non-Psi core interest packages
items.notes: Added the twelve remaining non-Psi interests, bringing the catalogue to fifteen. Pilot stores independent 30- and 40-point field choices; matching sample or custom fields merge through the existing ledger. Verified fixed fields, Art classification, doubled bases, cap warnings, allocation replay, partial drafts, backup validation and restore, mobile layout, and player/GM print output. Async remains with Psi support. All 104 tests and the production build pass.

items.title: Apply and trace aptitude check ego traits
items.notes: Added Acumen, Empathy, Fitness, Good Instincts, Quickness, and Resolve at three levels each. Check targets add five per level after aptitude multiplication, with trait source traces in the dossier and both print layouts. CP costs and backup validation use existing trait selections. Verified partial aptitudes, zeroes, level changes and removal, unchanged skill bases and language thresholds, save/reload/restore, keyboard access, 320 px layout, and every page of player/GM grayscale PDFs. All 111 tests and the production build pass.

items.title: Support repeatable Contact and Morph Familiarity purchases
items.notes: Added one-CP Contact purchases with a name and reputation network, and Morph Familiarity purchases with a morph type. Shared normalized scope keys prevent duplicates while preserving existing singleton trait validation. Each entry has independent add/remove controls, CP accounting, backup fields, dossier and player/GM print summaries, and persists across resleeving. Verified malformed imports preserve saved drafts, restore-as-copy, keyboard access, 320 px layout, and every page of grayscale PDFs. All 118 tests and the production build pass.

items.title: Apply repeatable Hardening stress immunities and penalties
items.notes: Added one-CP Hardening choices for Alienation, Helplessness, and Violence, with duplicate checks and cumulative minus-ten WIL Check and Persuade Test penalties per purchase. Unknown remains deferred with required Psi support under errata 1.4. The ledger keeps skill ratings and cap validation separate from adjusted test targets; specialization targets include the penalty once. Verified partial drafts, invalid scopes, positive and negative check traces, CP costs, cap enforcement, allocation replay, save/reload, backup rejection and restore, removal, mobile table scrolling, and all five grayscale player/GM PDF pages. Trait entries now stay together when printed. All 127 tests and the production build pass.

items.title: Derive core ego stats and apply Composure
items.notes: Added traced Initiative, Lucidity, Trauma Threshold, and Insanity Rating to the live editor, dossier, and both print layouts. Division uses normal nearest-integer rounding under the core rules. Composure costs two CP, adds five Lucidity, and propagates into dependent mental health stats. Missing aptitudes remain pending and check-only modifiers do not alter aptitude bases. Verified rounding boundaries, zeroes, partial drafts, CP release on removal, backup validation and restore, resleeving, keyboard access, 320 px layouts, and all six grayscale player/GM/incomplete-player PDF pages. All 136 tests and the production build pass. Infection Rating remains deferred with Psi support.

items.title: Apply the Instability ego trait
items.notes: Added both levels, the shared CP bonus, and signed Lucidity penalties that flow into Trauma Threshold and Insanity Rating. Verified the shared cap, pending values, stacking with Composure, removal, backup validation, first-sleeve save and reload, and both Edge previews with print CSS. All 139 tests and the production build pass.

items.title: Apply the six negative aptitude check ego traits
items.notes: Added all three levels of Feebleness, Indifference, Obtuseness, Poor Coordination, Poor Instincts, and Timidity, including the corrected Timidity CP bonus. Verified all levels, the shared negative trait cap, stacking with Resolve and Hardening, backup validation, save and reload, removal, and both Edge print previews. Attribution remains visible when modifiers cancel. All 142 tests and the production build pass.

items.title: Swap fixed-cost starting gear between supported pack items
items.notes: Added equal-GP replacements with source links and Restricted labels. Verified first-sleeve alternatives, payload-cost exclusions, backup round-trip and rejection of invalid or duplicate swaps, original-item restoration, stale choices, save and reload, resleeving, 390 px layout, and the player print preview with print styling. All 145 tests and the production build pass.

items.title: Add core infomorph sleeves and their optional starting gear pack
items.notes: Added Digimorph, Ikon, Agent, and Operator with sourced health, MP costs, and pools. Added the optional 10 GP Infomorph pack in the campaign slot with equal-GP swap support. Verified eligibility, backup validation, filtering and comparison, 390 px layout, save and reload, resleeving, and both print previews. All 148 tests and the production build pass.

items.title: Budget starting Morph Points and temporary Flex
items.notes: Added the 6 MP default and GM override, Resources at all four levels, sourced prices for all seven selectable sleeves, an over-budget warning, and temporary Flex that expires on resleeving. Verified zero and pending values, odd MP, the Flex cap, invalid allowance rejection, backup restore, the 390 px editor, save and reload, and both print previews. All 153 tests and the production build pass.

items.title: Buy extra starting equipment and swap supported Gear chapter items
items.notes: Added eighteen sourced items for one-unit purchases at 1, 2, or 3 MP by complexity and equal-GP pack swaps. Verified quantities, price tiers, source and Restricted labels, pending and over-budget drafts, Flex recalculation, backup validation, 390 px layout, save and reload, resleeving, and both print previews. All 156 tests and the production build pass.

items.title: Apply starting morph trait costs, bonuses, and Toughness health
items.notes: Added Toughness, Dominant Limb, Hypersensitivity, Planned Obsolescence, Proprietary Tech, and Zero-G Nausea for eligible physical sleeves. Verified the 6 MP cap, derived health and rounding, backup validation, the 390 px editor, save and reload, both print previews, and that traits stay on their original sleeve after resleeving. All 161 tests and the production build pass.
